subject: POC prerequisites: environment owners, dependencies & timeline (MAP draft)
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Mike Thompson <mike.thompson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: POC prerequisites: environment owners, dependencies & timeline (MAP draft)

Hi Mike — great sync this morning. Thanks for walking through the use case and the success criteria.

Attached is a lightweight MAP (v0.1) that captures the POC milestones we discussed and the ownership we recommend. High-level items I want to confirm here:

- Target POC launch date (customer access): 2026-08-11
- Required infra items: VPC peering, IP allowlist, SSO (SAML) integration, secrets/KMS access pattern, and DNS entries for callback endpoints
- Redwood owners: Karthik for networking & SSO config, Ben for secrets/KMS and console access, Jasmine (me) as overall PM/point of contact
- Customer owners: Mike to own VPC peering and subnet details; Kelsey to coordinate SSO metadata and IDP test account

Next steps I propose:
1) Mike to share target subnets & egress IP ranges by EOD Thu 07/23 (we need to add them to our allowlist)
2) Kelsey to provide SAML metadata + test user by 07/26
3) Redwood to provision a dedicated staging environment and share temporary credentials and a short runbook by 07/30

I attached the MAP spreadsheet (ACM-4532_MAP_v0.1.xlsx) that includes a milestone tracker and an initial dependency table. Please review and reply with any corrections to the owners/timeline. If you prefer, we can convert this to a mutual action item list in your procurement tracker.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[jasmine.liu@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: ACM-4532_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prerequisites: environment owners, dependencies & timeline (MAP draft)

Jasmine — quick technical notes after skimming the MAP:

- VPC peering: We need the exact CIDR ranges for AcmeHealth's peered subnets and any overlapping ranges flagged. If they have transitive routing policies, we also need confirmation there are no overlapping managed routes.
- IP allowlist: ask for both source and destination egress ranges (customer may need to allow our egress IPs; we need to publish those to them).
- SSO/SAML: we will support SP-initiated SAML. Request: Kelsey should provide the metadata.xml and a test user with the role that mirrors production mapping. We will need a temporary SSO test tenant (or their staging IDP).
- Secrets/KMS: Ben to confirm whether customer secrets will be stored in Redwood-managed KV or passed via mounted KMS — depends on their compliance requirements. If they require KMS wrap, we need key ARN and IAM principal to configure.

I've added a short technical checklist to the MAP (column "Tech blocker") — I'll hand this to Laura to include in the staging runbook.

Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer

Cc: Kelsey Rogers <kelsey.rogers@acmehealth.com>, CloudInfra Consultant <infra+acme@thirdparty.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC prerequisites: environment owners, dependencies & timeline (MAP draft)

Thanks Jasmine — review looks good from our side. Quick answers to the technical asks:

- Subnets & egress ranges: attached is a small spreadsheet with the two candidate subnets we'll peer (10.40.16.0/24 and 10.40.17.0/24) and our outbound NAT IP ranges (34.210.22.45, 34.210.22.46). We'll confirm whether we want to publish a static egress range or use a NAT gateway — should have final answer by Friday 07/24. (See attachment: acme_subnets_and_fw.xlsx)
- SAML metadata: Kelsey will send the metadata.xml and create a test user (kelsey.test@acmehealth.com) by Monday 07/26.
- KMS: we will not provide our KMS key for the POC; we prefer Redwood manage ephemeral secrets for this trial. If the later phase requires KMS wrap, we'll specify the key ARN during contract negotiations.

We are aligned on the 08/11 target window for initial access. If Redwood needs to schedule a short network validation call, ping infra@acmehealth and CC me.

Best,
Mike Thompson
Senior Cloud Architect, AcmeHealth

Attachment: acme_subnets_and_fw.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks all — good progress. Quick summary and immediate actions (updated MAP v0.2 in Drive link):

A) Confirmed items
- Acme subnets to peer: 10.40.16.0/24, 10.40.17.0/24
- Temporary egress IPs: 34.210.22.45, 34.210.22.46 (pending NAT decision on 07/24)
- KMS stance: Redwood to manage ephemeral secrets for POC (customer may revisit for contracted phase)

B) Owners & short actions (owner — due)
- Mike Thompson — provide final NAT decision + any additional firewall ACLs (07/24)
- Kelsey Rogers — upload SAML metadata.xml and create kelsey.test account (07/26)
- Karthik Iyer — prep peering runbook and test plan, list of required routing rules (07/28)
- Ben Carter — prepare secrets bootstrap process and console access roles for kelsey.test (07/30)
- Jasmine Liu — schedule network validation call if needed and update MAP to v0.2 (done) (07/22)

C) Blockers: none blockers now that we have subnets; watch for NAT egress decision

I'll convert this into the mutual action tracker for procurement if Acme wants a shared doc. For now I've left the MAP editable in Drive and added a technical checklist for Karthik and Ben.

If there are no objections I will mark the MAP "owner confirmed" and move the milestone target to 08/11 in v0.2 tonight.

Thanks — Jasmine
